history.reason: Reads one 1m bucket per tick (tail); the alert windows are kept as 60 buckets of 1m and the 1d compliance window as 720 buckets of 2m; warming a new rule reads 1h at 1m and 1d at 2m (recent).

extended:
groups:
  - name: slos/1m
    interval: 1m
    rules:
      - alert: CheckoutAvailability
        labels:
          team: pay
        annotations:
          summary: checkout is burning its error budget
        slo:
          objective: 0.99
          window: 1d
          sli:
            bad: sum(increase(errors_total{job="checkout"}[$window]))
            total: sum(increase(requests_total{job="checkout"}[$window]))
          alerts:
            - severity: page
              long_window: 10m
              short_window: 2m
              burn_rate: 10
          min_events: 0
          min_coverage: 0
          max_series: 10
          given:
            - alerts
            - min_coverage
            - objective
            - sli
            - window
